package http3

import (
	"math"
	"testing"

	"github.com/quic-go/qpack"
)

func TestRelayRequestSchemeRequired(t *testing.T) {
	for _, scheme := range []string{"missing", "", "1https", "https:", "ht tp", "https/", "\u212Ahttps", "\u0130https"} {
		t.Run(scheme, func(t *testing.T) {
			headers := []qpack.HeaderField{{Name: ":method", Value: "GET"}, {Name: ":authority", Value: "relay.test"}, {Name: ":path", Value: "/"}}
			if scheme != "missing" {
				headers = append(headers, qpack.HeaderField{Name: ":scheme", Value: scheme})
			}
			if _, err := requestFromHeaders(decodeFromSlice(headers), math.MaxInt, nil); err == nil {
				t.Fatal("accepted an ordinary request without a valid scheme")
			}
		})
	}
	for _, scheme := range []string{"https", "HTTP", "f+1.bar-baz"} {
		headers := []qpack.HeaderField{{Name: ":method", Value: "GET"}, {Name: ":authority", Value: "relay.test"}, {Name: ":path", Value: "/"}, {Name: ":scheme", Value: scheme}}
		if _, err := requestFromHeaders(decodeFromSlice(headers), math.MaxInt, nil); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("valid scheme %q rejected: %v", scheme, err)
		}
	}
}
